verdict.rationale: Stripe schedules recurring work only within billing: Billing automates recurring payments, renewals and trials, and Smart Retries automatically re-attempts failed payments. General-purpose workflow automation comes only through the third-party Kyber app in the Dashboard, and it is triggered by events rather than scheduled. Missing for 10: a first-party scheduler for arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows, cron-style scheduling via the API, MCP or CLI for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
